```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Importing First DF (ALL DATA)

```{r}

df <- read_excel("../data/Corn_all.xlsx")

df

```

# Range filtering bands

```{r}
df_filtered <- df %>%
  select(
    1:7,
    Band_5:Band_293
  )

df_filtered
```



```{r}
df_pivot <- df_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Band_"),
    names_to = "bands",
    values_to = "reflectance"
  )

df_pivot
```


# Creating Numeric wavelength column

```{r}
df_pivot <- df_pivot %>%
  mutate(
    band_number = as.numeric(gsub("Band_", "", bands)),
    wavelength = 393.80 + (band_number - 1) * 2.02
  )

df_pivot
```

# Checking wavelength distributions.

```{r}

spectral_p <- ggplot(
  df_pivot,
  aes(
    x = wavelength,
    y = reflectance,
    group = interaction(ID, DAP),
    color = as.factor(`N_treatmen`)
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Wavelength (nm)",
    y = "Reflectance",
    color = "N treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

spectral_p

```
